## ✅ Executive Summary
This readout covers 4 functional requirements for Customer Loyalty Points Redemption at Checkout, assessed at High overall impact. The dependency graph is valid, with 7 nodes flowing from a single design step through a new Redemption Orchestrator into three parallel workstreams (Loyalty deduction, payment sequencing, and the checkout balance widget) that converge through audit writing into a single QA/UAT/compliance sign-off gate, with no cycles. The biggest risk is that the new Redemption Orchestrator — the component behind both FR-002 and FR-004 — carries High blast radius on both requirements, concentrating schedule and regression risk in one new service sitting in the critical checkout path. Two open questions remain, on the scope of the 24-hour reversal window and on whether the $10 minimum order threshold is configurable, plus a noted coverage gap around guest checkout. A data-quality flag is also carried forward: Loyalty Service's CMDB entry conflicts with its actual production status.

## Requirements

### FR-001: Real-Time Points Balance Display at Checkout
**Statement:** As a shopper, I want to see my current loyalty points balance on the checkout page, so that I can decide whether to redeem points before paying.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Performance | Balance must render within 500ms of checkout page load | Stakeholder interview, Checkout team |
| Availability | Balance display must degrade gracefully (hide, not error) if the Loyalty Service is unavailable | SRE standard |

### FR-002: Redeem Points for Order Discount
**Statement:** As a shopper, I want to redeem some or all of my points for a discount on my current order, so that I can lower what I pay at checkout.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Security | Redemption must be idempotent — a retried request must not double-redeem points | Security team standard |
| Compliance | Redemption transactions must be reversible within 24 hours per consumer protection policy | Legal/Compliance team |

### FR-003: Points Redemption Audit Trail
**Statement:** As a compliance officer, I want every redemption attempt to produce an immutable audit record, so that redemptions can be reviewed and reconciled.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Compliance | Every redemption must produce an immutable audit record retained for 7 years | Compliance team |

### FR-004: Partial Redemption with Minimum Order Threshold
**Statement:** As a shopper, I want to redeem only part of my points balance on orders above a minimum value, so that I retain flexibility over how many points I spend.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Business Rule | Minimum order value for partial redemption is $10 | Product team |

## Impact: What This Touches

**Existing-System Impact**

| Existing System (CI) | Touched? | How / Why Not | Component(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Checkout Service | Yes | Adds a new redemption line-item type and idempotency handling | FR-002, FR-004 |
| Loyalty Service | Yes | Serves balance reads and processes the redemption deduction | FR-001, FR-002 |
| Payment Gateway Integration | Yes | Must sequence redemption before payment capture | FR-002 |
| Compliance Archive | Yes | Receives new immutable audit records | FR-003 |
| CRM | No | Loyalty points are not stored or referenced in CRM | — |
| Inventory Service | No | Redemption does not affect stock levels | — |

**Components Identified**

| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Checkout Balance Widget (new) | Low | Frontend-only display component, read-only |
| FR-002 | Redemption Orchestrator (new) | High | New service coordinating Checkout, Loyalty, and Payment Gateway in the critical checkout path |
| FR-002 | Loyalty Service Deduction Endpoint (existing) | Medium | Existing service gains a new write endpoint |
| FR-003 | Audit Record Writer (new) | Medium | New write path into the existing Compliance Archive |
| FR-004 | Redemption Orchestrator (existing, extended) | High | Same critical-path component as FR-002, extended with partial-redemption logic |

**Blast Radius Rollup:** 2 High / 2 Medium / 1 Low — the two High items are the same Redemption Orchestrator component, meaning schedule risk to that one new service now sits behind two requirements' timelines, not just one.

## Assumptions, Constraints, Risks & Open Questions

### Assumptions
- **Loyalty Service exposes a real-time balance API** (underlies FR-001, FR-002): We assume the existing Loyalty Service already exposes a low-latency balance-read endpoint; no new balance store is being built.
- **Points-to-currency conversion rate is centrally configured** (underlies FR-002, FR-004): We assume a single, centrally configured conversion rate applies storewide; no per-SKU or per-category rate overrides are in scope.

### Constraints
- **No checkout-flow schema changes** (constrains FR-002): The order schema in Checkout Service may not be modified; redemption must be recorded as a separate line-item type using existing extension fields.
- **7-year audit retention on existing archive tier** (constrains FR-003): Audit records must use the existing compliance archive tier; no new long-term storage system may be introduced.

### Risks
- **Idempotency key collisions under retry storms** (affects FR-002, program-level): A checkout retry storm (e.g., during a payment gateway outage) could produce colliding idempotency keys if the existing Checkout Service retry logic isn't reused as-is.
- **Audit trail write amplification** (affects FR-003, program-level): Writing an immutable audit record on every redemption attempt (not just successful ones) could meaningfully increase write volume to the compliance archive tier.

### Open Questions
- FR-002 (Compliance): TBD whether the 24-hour reversal window applies to partial redemptions (FR-004) as well, or only full redemptions.
- FR-004 (Business Rule): TBD whether the $10 minimum order threshold is store-configurable or a single global constant.
- **Coverage gap:** Guest checkout (unauthenticated users) was out of scope for this PRD and has no FR coverage; flagged for a follow-up PRD.

## External Dependencies
- Payment Gateway Integration's sequencing hook is owned by the Payments platform team; requires their sign-off on hook placement before FR-002 can be sequenced.
- Compliance Archive's write API has a documented rate limit of 200 writes/sec; FR-003's audit volume must be modeled against this limit.

## Flags & Data Quality
- Loyalty Service's CMDB entry lists it as "deprecated — migration in progress" while this assessment's technical touch check found it still actively serving production traffic; this CMDB/reality mismatch should be resolved before FR-001/FR-002 implementation begins.
